beats.label: The data
beats.text: **108,000** adults, home noise estimated from **traffic,** trains and **planes.**
beats.note: Nguyen et al., AHA Scientific Sessions 2026 abstract (preliminary)

beats.label: What showed up
beats.text: Above **50 decibels,** odds of high cholesterol, blood pressure or diabetes ran **8–10%** higher.

beats.label: The surprise
beats.text: The link looked **similar** for people who slept **well** and **badly.**

beats.label: 3 fixes he suggests
beats.text: Bedroom on the **quiet** side. Better **windows.** **Earplugs** at night.
beats.note: Lead author Dr. Joseph Nguyen, Mass General

beats.label: Reality check
beats.text: One **unreviewed** study of noise averages. A **link,** not proof noise **causes** heart disease.
Follow for new heart research, **minus** the **hype.**
